understanding.description: What the enquiry is actually asking for.

wants.description: One sentence: what the customer wants done.

services.description: Services implied by the enquiry, in plain words.

facilityType.description: Restaurant, hotel, mall, hospital, school, office, other, or unknown.

urgency.description: How soon they appear to need it.

estimatedValue.description: Rough opportunity value in the lead's currency. 0 when there is no basis to estimate.

missingInfo.description: What an actioner must ask before this can be quoted.

risks.description: Anything that could make this a bad job to take.

relevance.description: Whether this lead is ours, judged only against the supplied SERVICE SCOPE.

verdict.description: relevant = service and location both covered. outside_region = service covered but location is not. not_relevant = we do not do this work.

reasons.description: Why, citing the scope. One short sentence each.

matchedServices.description: Service codes from the scope that this lead matches.

unmatchedServices.description: Anything requested that the scope does not cover.

value.description: Integer from 0 to 100. Higher means more worth pursuing now.

recommendation.description: What a human should do next.

nextAction.description: One concrete next step, e.g. 'call to book a site survey'.
